scope_split_rationale: R038 official topic '策略 CI/CD 驗證鏈' encompasses an entire strategy verification pipeline spanning backtest, replay, 10-level validation, market reality modeling, lifecycle management, NEA/confidence calibration, and metrics. The full scope is too large for a single candidate. It is split into 7 internal subtasks (R038a–R038g), each with focused deliverable and acceptance gate.

R038a.name: Market Reality integration contract + decision trace replay
requirements: Taiwan cost / slippage / liquidity / fill probability / partial fill compatibility

R038c.name: L5-L9 validation chain
requirements: L8 Probabilistic Sharpe / Reality Check / SPA
L9 Paper trading 6–12 months + pre-live stress
explicit prohibition: L0 backtest alone is NOT live readiness

R038d.name: Strategy lifecycle automation
requirements: paper→live_small, live_small→live_normal, capital increase require human approval

R038e.name: Metrics contract + CI evidence artifact pipeline

R038f.name: NEA / confidence calibration integration
requirements: net_edge = p_hat * W_hat - (1-p_hat) * L_hat - C - S - B - T - R - U
raw confidence must not directly amplify position size

subtasks_are_not_formal_rounds: R038a–R038g are internal R038 subtask labels only. They are NOT formal main rounds. They do NOT modify the 161-round official topic table. They do NOT advance next_round_to_dispatch. Any instruction treating R038a–R038g as R039/R040 replacements is a direct FAIL.
shared_acceptance_gates: source reality audit: no stub / TODO / pass-only
tests reality audit: positive + negative + boundary tests
direct_FAIL_conditions: Risk Gate only live, backtest/replay cannot verify veto
ignores costs / slippage / liquidity / partial fill
applies US/crypto assumptions to Taiwan market
raw confidence directly amplifies position size
strategy upgrades itself to live/capital without human approval

R038_final_close_gate.description: R038 can only be considered for final close after all R038a–R038g are completed, each with manual review PASS, merge/push/CI green, and a dedicated R038 final close audit. Until then: R038_completed=FALSE, next_round_to_dispatch=R038, R039-R048 accepted=FALSE, R049 started=FALSE.
